answer: Software can mint fake pilots, but a coast office sells only one ebb stand on the island's north jetty. The booked key deposits 53 units and seals a unique brass token as H(token||ebb||key) before the horn. It must occupy the vertex pin for nine minutes and call seven range marks a tide staff checks within 0.5 m. The run counts only if the token is unspent, the pin log has one occupant, and the seal opens. A late stand, reused token, or wild mark forfeits 22 units and cancels the next ten ebbs. A clerk signing two pin logs in one blast forfeits 81 units and is stood down 14 epochs.
